full_judgment: 9. After the repeal of the said sub-section 5 of 167 by Act No. 42 of 1992 substituted by new sub-section 5 there is no such provision for stopping further investigation. It is well settled that procedural law takes effect retrospectively. In this connection reference may be made to the case reported in (1994) 14 BLD (AD) 143 (State vs. Alia Mia). So it cannot now be argued on the basis of repealed provision of sub-section 5 of section 167 of the Code that the petitioners were entitled to the benefit of stoppage of further investigation against them and the charge-sheet submitted was illegal. We have already found that the stopping of further investigation did not create any vested right in favour of petitioners so as to enable them to get the benefit of the repealed provision of sub-section 5 of section 167 of the Code. It has already been found that charge-sheet was submitted within the time allowed by the Sessions Judge.
